goldsharp_prehistory_policy.allowed_rows: rows strictly before the first historical timestamp for the same timeframe

historical_replay.atr14_method: simple arithmetic rolling mean of the latest 14 true ranges
historical_replay.event_order: exact M1 entry and complete-horizon eligibility before event/onset detection

live_operation.purpose: new closed-bar observation for live audit and future signal generation
live_operation.append_rule: use goldsharp rows strictly after the historical maximum bar-open time for operational decisions
live_operation.overlap_rows: allowed for continuity checks but never eligible as new live decisions
live_operation.latest_row: closed by CSV contract; do not delete as open
